Define the future of mobility.
Careers

We’re building a Universal Autonomy Platform that will transform mobility for everyone.

We’re just getting started.

Why Nuro

The Nuro Driver™ is an industry-leading, AI-first autonomous driving system that combines proprietary hardware and generalized self-driving software. Our technology has been successfully deployed across multiple vehicle platforms in three states.

Why Nuro

Our partners are household names. Our investors are best-in-class. And our approach has been recognized by regulators and policymakers with industry-first operating permits/exemptions.

Why Nuro

Safety is our highest priority. Our autonomous vehicles and operations are designed with multiple layers of safety measures, from rigorous testing and validation to continuous monitoring and improvements. Our goal is to ensure the highest level of safety for both our team members and the communities in which we operate.

Driven by values.

Earn it
We seek and expect excellence and are not afraid of hard work.
1% better every day
We continuously focus on improving both as individuals and as a company.
Find a way
We embrace uncertainty and thrive on solving the hardest problems.
Act now
We trust our team's judgment—everyone is a problem solver.
One team
Nuro only succeeds if we are all working toward a common goal.
Welcome to Nuro.
Our company & culture
Come as you are.
Diversity. Equity. & Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a business that reflects our belief in the importance of a world in which everyone is welcomed, everyone is accepted, and everyone is valued.
